## Team Visualizations

<!-- Each teammate: agree as a team on who's making which plot before anyone starts, so
     no two people create the same visualization. Then add your own section below with
     your name and your one plot. -->

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(palmerpenguins)
```



### Luke Underhill — ["Bill Length by Species"]

```{r}

penguins |> ggplot(aes(x = species, y = bill_length_mm, fill = species)) + geom_boxplot()

```


### [Emily Willadson] — ["Flipper Length by Species"]

```{r}
# Box plot comparing distributions of Flipper Length across species
penguins |> ggplot(aes(x = species, y = flipper_length_mm, fill = species)) + geom_boxplot() +
  labs(
    x = "Flipper Length",
    y = "Species",
    fill = "Species"
  )
```


### Sanjana Sunkara — ["Bill Length vs Body Mass by Species]

```{r}

penguins |> ggplot(aes(x = species, y = bill_length_mm, fill = species)) + geom_boxplot()

```

### [Kevin Lin] — ["Body Mass by Species"]


# Make your agreed-upon plot here, e.g.:

 penguins |> 
  ggplot(
    aes(x = bill_length_mm, y = body_mass_g, colour = species)) +

   labs(
